_doc: Retrofit catalogue v0.2. twin_edits are physics parameters applied to the Level-1 twin (U-values are typical engineering assumptions; check against RdSAP 10 tables). Savings are NEVER stored here: they come from rerunning the twin. Cost rule: only items with cost_status 'sourced' or 'secondary_source' produce cost figures; 'unsourced' items return cost = null with a reason and are excluded from cost-based ranking (Pareto net cost) until sourced.

primary_source.title: BEIS (2017) Domestic cost assumptions: what does it cost to retrofit homes? Table 3, Summary findings from literature review (lowest / mean / highest cost per home)

uplift.index: ONS CPI INDEX 00: ALL ITEMS 2015=100 (series D7BT, dataset MM23)

assumptions: BEIS Table 3 costs are per home across literature sources (not dwelling-type specific); dwelling-type scaling is a later refinement.
CPI is a general price index; construction cost inflation may differ. Stated as a limitation.
